source_identity: Classification of the Functions of Government (COFOG), 1999
independence_basis: This frame classifies the functions or socioeconomic objectives of general government expenditure. Although COFOG and ISIC both sit within the broader United Nations statistical-classification ecosystem, they are distinct classification lineages with different target concepts: government-purpose classification versus kind of economic activity. This structural-independence claim remains subject to substantive scientific review.
audit_note: UNSD lists COFOG 1999 as operational. An official COFOG revision is underway and is anticipated to be completed around 2028. Treat COFOG 1999 as legacy-current for this construction cycle. A future revised COFOG must not retroactively rewrite this source-frame record.
